title: Disney sues FCC and its chair, escalating fight against Trump's chief censor
summary: Disney today sued the Federal Communications Commission and FCC Chairman Brendan Carr in a lawsuit that aims to stop what it called a “campaign of censorship” waged by the Trump administration against ABC.
